description: Flat metadata schema for individual transmission electron microscopy (TEM) records from genetically modified plant cells with immunogold labeling, including sample preparation, microscopy settings, image resolution, and plant genotype/phenotype descriptors.

record_id.descr: Unique identifier for the individual TEM metadata record or image. Example: 'TEM_IMG_0001'.

specimen_id.descr: Identifier for the biological specimen, tissue block, or sample associated with the image.

plant_species.descr: Scientific name of the plant species. Example: 'Arabidopsis thaliana'.

plant_cultivar_or_ecotype.descr: Cultivar, ecotype, or accession of the plant line. Example: 'Col-0'.

transgenic_line_id.descr: Identifier for the genetically modified plant line used in the study.

transgene_name.descr: Name of the tagged protein or transgene expressed in the plant line.

tag_type.descr: Type of tag fused to the protein of interest. Acceptable values may include GFP, mCherry, HA, FLAG, Myc, epitope tag, or other.

tag_localization_target.descr: Intended subcellular or organellar localization target of the tagged protein, if known.

genetic_modification_method.descr: Method used to generate the line, such as Agrobacterium transformation, CRISPR/Cas, or other.

zygosity_or_line_state.descr: Genetic state of the line, such as homozygous, heterozygous, hemizygous, or wild type control.

phenotype_summary.descr: Observed phenotype of the plant line relevant to the study, such as altered growth, chlorosis, stress sensitivity, or no visible phenotype.

stress_condition.descr: Stress treatment applied before sampling, if any. Example: drought, high light, salt, cold, pathogen challenge, or none.

stress_condition_value.descr: Numeric value associated with the stress treatment, when applicable. Example: salt concentration, light intensity, temperature, duration, or dose.

stress_condition_unit.descr: Unit for the stress_condition_value. Example: mM, µmol photons m^-2 s^-1, °C, h, or mg/L.

sample_tissue_type.descr: Plant tissue or cell type imaged. Example: leaf mesophyll, epidermis, guard cell, root tip, vascular tissue.

sample_developmental_stage.descr: Developmental stage or age of the plant/tissue at sampling.

fixation_method.descr: Primary fixation approach used. Example: chemical fixation, cryofixation, high-pressure freezing.

primary_fixative.descr: Primary fixative reagent(s) used. Example: glutaraldehyde, paraformaldehyde, or combinations.

primary_fixative_concentration.descr: Concentration of the primary fixative, if applicable. Example: 2.5%.

primary_fixative_unit.descr: Unit for the primary_fixative_concentration. Example: %, mM.

postfixative.descr: Post-fixative reagent used, if any. Example: osmium tetroxide.

postfixative_concentration.descr: Concentration of the post-fixative reagent, if applicable.

postfixative_unit.descr: Unit for the postfixative_concentration. Example: %, mM.

buffer_used.descr: Buffer used during fixation or washing. Example: phosphate buffer, cacodylate buffer.

buffer_ph.descr: pH of the buffer used during sample preparation, if measured.

dehydration_method.descr: Dehydration approach used prior to embedding. Example: ethanol series, acetone series, or none for cryo methods.

embedding_medium.descr: Embedding resin or medium used. Example: LR White, Spurr's resin, Epon, Araldite, or other.

embedding_temperature.descr: Temperature used during embedding/polymerization, if relevant. Example: 60 for resin curing.

sectioning_method.descr: Sectioning approach used to obtain TEM sections. Example: ultramicrotomy, cryosectioning.

section_thickness.descr: Thickness of the section imaged, typically in nanometers.

sectioning_instrument.descr: Instrument used for sectioning, such as ultramicrotome model or cryoultramicrotome.

grid_type.descr: TEM grid type/support used for sections. Example: copper grid, nickel grid, formvar-coated grid.

labeling_method.descr: Immunolabeling or contrast-labeling method used. Example: immunogold, post-embedding immunogold, pre-embedding labeling.

primary_antibody_target.descr: Antigen targeted by the primary antibody, usually the protein of interest or tag.

primary_antibody_host_species.descr: Host species in which the primary antibody was raised. Example: rabbit, mouse, goat.

primary_antibody_dilution.descr: Dilution factor used for the primary antibody. Example: 1:200.

secondary_antibody_host_species.descr: Host species or source of the secondary antibody, if used.

gold_particle_size.descr: Diameter of the immunogold particle label in nanometers.

labeling_controls_present.descr: Whether negative/positive labeling controls were included for this record or experimental set.

labeling_control_type.descr: Type of control used, such as no-primary antibody, wild type, or known-positive control.

staining_method.descr: Counterstain or heavy-metal staining used after sectioning. Example: uranyl acetate, lead citrate.

staining_duration_unit.descr: Unit for staining_duration. Example: min, h.

tem_instrument_model.descr: Model of the transmission electron microscope used.

accelerating_voltage.descr: Accelerating voltage used during TEM imaging, in kilovolts.

objective_aperture_used.descr: Whether an objective aperture was used during imaging.

camera_model.descr: Camera or detector model used to acquire the TEM image.

magnification.descr: Nominal magnification used for the image acquisition.

pixel_size.descr: Pixel size at the specimen level, typically in nanometers per pixel.

spatial_scale_bar_length.descr: Length represented by the scale bar in the image.

spatial_scale_bar_unit.descr: Unit for spatial_scale_bar_length. Example: nm, µm.

image_format.descr: File format of the stored image. Example: TIFF, DM3, PNG.

image_processing_applied.descr: Whether any post-acquisition image processing was applied beyond routine adjustments.

image_processing_description.descr: Description of image processing steps applied, such as contrast adjustment, denoising, or deconvolution.

subcellular_compartment.descr: Main organelle or subcellular compartment visible in the record. Example: chloroplast, mitochondrion, nucleus, vacuole, plasma membrane.

membrane_face_or_domain.descr: Specific membrane face or domain if relevant. Example: thylakoid membrane, outer envelope, stromal side, grana.

immunogold_count.descr: Number of immunogold particles counted in the analyzed field or region.

area_analyzed.descr: Area analyzed for particle counting or localization quantification, in square micrometers when available.

localization_annotation.descr: Interpretive localization call for the protein signal, such as organelle-associated, membrane-associated, luminal, cytosolic, or background.

observer_or_operator.descr: Name or identifier of the person who prepared or acquired the record.

acquisition_date.descr: Date of image acquisition or record generation.

notes.descr: Additional free-text notes relevant to this individual record, such as anomalies, artifacts, or deviations from protocol.
